name: trdsql-multi-result-export-documents
instr:
trdsql cannot export multiple result-producing SQL statements as one ordered document with independently observable identities, schemas, rows, and outcomes. Implement coherent streaming, buffered, typed, rendered, in-memory, and CLI representations without changing single-result behavior.

In multi-result mode, `WriteFormat` gives each result-producing statement one ordered begin and terminal boundary, including empty results; non-result statements get none. All built-in formats, including CSV, JSON, JSONL, YAML, LTSV, RAW, TSV, TBLN, table, and vertical output, preserve unambiguous membership and established conversion, escaping, streaming, and layout semantics. JSON and YAML produce one parseable top-level document. Each JSONL line remains independently decodable, with rows emitted incrementally.

`NewSliceWriter` copies rows, columns, and types into separate ordered groups while preserving single-result `Table` access. Preserve completed outcomes after writer failure or cancellation, identify the terminal result accurately, and neither execute later statements nor report them completed. Boundary setup failures fabricate no rows. Unsupported custom writers in document mode produce the existing process-visible diagnostic and nonzero exit. Legacy `Writer` implementations and default single-result executions retain their lifecycle, output composition, and error propagation. `NewExporter(writer, options ...WriteOpt)` constructs the corresponding `WriteFormat`, with `OutMultiRes
